title: NTDS database filename created in a staging or remote location
description: Detects creation or rename of a file named ntds.dit in rooted profile, temporary, recycle-bin or UNC locations.

hypothesis.summary: An adversary may stage an Active Directory database copy under its conventional filename in a temporary directory or network share for later credential extraction.
hypothesis.rationale: The filename is not proof of NTDS contents or credential extraction. Renamed/other-location copies, legitimate backups and incomplete file telemetry limit coverage.
hypothesis.detection_goal: Detects creation or rename of a file named ntds.dit in rooted profile, temporary, recycle-bin or UNC locations.

data_sources.name: Microsoft Defender for Endpoint file events

triage.summary: The filename is not proof of NTDS contents or credential extraction. Renamed/other-location copies, legitimate backups and incomplete file telemetry limit coverage.
steps: Review the writing process, account, device role and full path, and establish whether the file is actually an NTDS database.
Correlate shadow-copy or backup activity, SYSTEM hive access, archive creation and outbound transfer without collecting secrets into the repository.
Confirm the approved backup or incident-response owner; otherwise investigate possible directory-credential theft.
false_positives: Approved domain-controller backup, restore, migration or forensic collection staging an NTDS copy in one of the selected paths.

validation.expected_outcome: Match the bounded event, key/action/path or successful operation combination; reject one-field mutations, lookalikes and absent required fields. Synthetic tests do not establish live telemetry or production performance.

limitations: The filename is not proof of NTDS contents or credential extraction. Renamed/other-location copies, legitimate backups and incomplete file telemetry limit coverage.
Current-revision evidence is synthetic only. Validate full generated KQL, source fields, ingestion delay, alert volume and scoped exclusions in the target before enabling.
